metadata.description: Marketplace for the REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) plugin: REA MCP server + skills, runnable in Claude Code, Claude Desktop and claude.ai cloud sessions.

plugins.name: rea
plugins.description: REA MCP server + reverse-engineering skills. Engines (JDK 21, Ghidra 12.1.4, jadx, optional apktool/radare2) auto-install on first use on Windows, macOS and Linux; reverse-engineering prompts are routed to REA automatically; Windows can also run REA inside WSL.
